heightM.note: the shelters' roofs above the street (deck 3 m plus shelters 7.5 m): the model's top

lengthM.note: the stretch modelled, centred on the Wikidata point (the boardwalk runs about 4.3 km in all)

headingDeg.note: the boardwalk's compass heading (east-north-east along the shore), by eye

beachM.note: the beach between the boardwalk and the water line

pier.note: the fishing pier: width (widthM) and length out from the boardwalk (depthM)

shelter.note: a generic roofed shelter on the deck

shelterM.note: the shelters' height above the deck

pierWestM.note: how far west of the Wikidata point the fishing pier leaves the boardwalk

readabilityScale.note: The deck is drawn 1.6 times its width so it reads along 2.7 km; lamps three times a lamp head. No rides, no signs, no text (LEGAL-1).

gameScale.note: Game scale (orchestrator decision 2026-10-08, the user may overrule): heights x1.6; lengths real, widths at the readability scale.
